title: Returns; place for filing.
bodyText: Returns shall be filed in the form and manner prescribed by the department.
bodyHtml: §235-99  Returns; place for filing.  Returns shall be filed in the form and manner prescribed by the department. [L Sp 1957, c 1, pt of §2; Supp, §121-33; am L 1967, c 37, §1; HRS §235-99; am L 2021, c 117, §9]
